purpose: Prospective PUBLIC flat-pallet expected structural-cue visibility AUX corpus. No current/V112 or modelscore driven construction.

query_emulation.q: original r + offset, new grid not original uncertainty9
query_emulation.q8: q0=query carrier; q1..7=[(x0,y0),(x1,y0),(x1,y1),(x0,y1),(midx,y0),(midx,y1),(x0,midy)] from source target bbox
query_emulation.context: exact finite non-sentinel q8 minmax, unclipped/unexpanded
query_emulation.L0: same formula at q0=r; native donor composition fixed for all9 queryjitters

donors.ranks0_to3: fold-specific cone RGBA with max extent .6/1.0/1.4/2.0 times L0; exact factor, no inherited .8L cap or whole-localcrop containment
donors.ranks4_to7: YCB [smallest object_id present in TRAIN and VAL excluding5/15/16,5,15,16]; fold-specific first eligible instance by stable original metadata order. Scale first feasible in(.6,1,1.4,2)*L0
donors.missing_or_infeasible: retain planned rank as U, no crossfold substitution

composition.canvas: native fullRGB, recipe + changed native patch stored; before image unchanged
composition.cover: all original cue uncertainty pixels intersecting RGB must have pastedalpha>=254/255; uncertainty unchanged, outsideimage flag retained
composition.sham: same donor/scale; alpha0 over whole cue uncertainty, some foreground visible in localwindow
composition.placements: deterministic geometry enumeration around largest opaque donor interior forcover; fixed radial translated candidates forsham; record candidate sequence. No modelscore filters.
composition.local_alpha_mass: measure and report cover/sham mass and difference; no matchingclaim whenimpossible
composition.failed_pair: bothchangedroles U, originalbefore D if factualavailable
composition.supervision: Region/component expected cue visibility D/E; shifts may cross materialedges withoutchangingcue label. Not nativecorner equality/pixel materialowner gold.
